data.one_liner: Android and iOS OTP autofill plugin using SMS User Consent and Retriever APIs.
data.what_it_does: It provides text editing controllers and interactors to automatically read and parse one-time passwords (OTP) from incoming SMS messages on Android and iOS. It also supports custom strategies like push notifications or testing inputs.
use_when: You need automated SMS verification code input (OTP) for phone authentication.
You need to support both Android SMS Retriever/User Consent APIs and iOS native text field autofill.
avoid_when: You only need standard text field input without SMS auto-reading capabilities.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports both SMS User Consent API and SMS Retriever API on Android.
Includes helper classes like OTPTextEditController and OTPInteractor for quick implementation.
Allows custom strategies (e.g., push notifications or testing).
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of native minimum SDK version on Android.
Relies on parsing SMS text formats correctly via regular expressions.
data.setup_notes: On Android, set minSdkVersion at least to 19 in android/app/build.gradle.

alternatives.name: pinput
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a complete customizable PIN input widget set rather than just text controller bindings.

alternatives.name: pin_code_fields
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a pin code field UI component.
